description: The three field metrics that feed ranking - LCP at 2.5s, INP at 200ms, CLS at 0.1 - are measured on real visitors at the 75th percentile. None of that is readable from source, but the causes are, and the causes are what gets changed.

gates.title: No Script Blocks The First Paint
gates.rule: Every external script carries defer, async, or type=module. A blocking script in the head stops parsing until it has been fetched and run, and the reader looks at nothing for the length of that round trip.
gates.fix: Add defer to anything that does not have to run before first paint; async to anything order-independent.

gates.title: Web Fonts Declare A Display Strategy
gates.rule: Every web font sets font-display. Without it text stays invisible until the font arrives, so the paint that gets measured is the one that waited for a download nobody needed to wait for.
gates.fix: Set font-display: swap on each @font-face, or the display option on the framework's font loader.

gates.title: The Largest Paint Is Prioritised
gates.rule: The hero image or font is preloaded or given a fetch priority. Otherwise its request waits to be discovered by the stylesheet that references it, which is a whole round trip late.
gates.fix: Preload the hero asset in the head, or mark it fetchpriority="high".

gates.title: Third-Party Origins Are Preconnected
gates.rule: A site pulling from three or more external origins opens those connections early. Each cold origin costs DNS, TCP and TLS before the first byte of the thing it was fetching.
gates.fix: Add rel="preconnect" for the origins on the critical path and rel="dns-prefetch" for the rest.

gates.title: Nothing Injects Markup After Paint
gates.rule: No document.write and no innerHTML assignment building markup at runtime. Content arriving after layout moves everything below it, and that movement is the metric.
gates.fix: Render the content server-side, or reserve its space before it arrives.

gates.title: The Back Button Still Works
gates.rule: Nothing traps the reader by rewriting history. Defeating the Back button became a named spam-policy violation in 2026 and is enforced with manual actions, not a demotion nobody can see.
gates.fix: Remove the history handler, or confirm one press of Back leaves the site.
